items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: And Bill Mathias had played drum with Silly Stamp... Ricard was playing bass with him... I thought... we must have been up about six months... we had straight away and went to play with other different fellas.

ctx.x: That's right, we talked about Ricard.

And Bill Mathias had played drum with Silly Stamp. He was a drummer a long time ago. When he made up this band, Ricard was playing bass with him. And Bill Mathias, did he playing drum, he was playing trombone with him. Albert Walters was playing trumpet. And Kit Clayton was playing with him. And we must have been up about six months. And I thought, when they knocked off at Higgins Shipyard, there were five and six hundred people would be docking off. And fellas coming through with their cars in a hurry. And they…
Yeah, some of his old records are a larger band. Yeah.
